name: print-social-your-digital-marketing-partner-poster-blue-red-duotone-wireframe
title: 'Your Digital Marketing Partner' poster with a red-duotone portrait and a wireframe mesh accent
whatItIs: A blue-bordered white poster with a bold high-contrast serif headline 'Your Digital Marketing Partner', a dotted pattern and solid orange circle accent, a red-duotone photo of a smiling person, a wireframe mesh grid shape, and a small connected-node logo mark with the brand name 'TARUKA'.
whatItMeans: Editorial and confident; pairing serif type with a duotone photo and wireframe mesh feels design-forward rather than templated.
techniques: Pair a high-contrast serif headline with a duotone photo.
Add a wireframe mesh shape as an abstract tech accent.
Use a connected-node icon as a distinctive small logo mark.

vocabulary.definition: A grid of lines suggesting a 3D or digital surface.
A mark built from connected dots, suggesting a network.
